en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of two large country houses set amidst a grassy slope with a forest in the background. Both houses have distinctive wooden framing and sloped roofs, typical of early 20th-century German rural architecture. There are wooden fences around the properties, and some small trees or plants can be seen near the houses. The text at the top reads 'Dr. Boerners Landhaus.' and at the bottom, more text identifies the location and the producer.
